headline: Washington posts 30-for-30 lists; Beijing names $30bn MFN cuts
deck: The White House recommends 77 Chinese and more than 1,600 U.S. lines; Commerce on Monday puts around 90 percent of a $30bn package at MFN.
body: The White House posted reciprocal lists of goods the United States and China "will consider" for reduced tariff treatment "consistent with their respective domestic laws and processes." [E1] Al Jazeera, reading that package, put the coverage at **$30bn** of each side’s imports and counted **77** Chinese goods and more than **1,600** U.S. products recommended for more favourable treatment. [E4]

China’s Ministry of Commerce announced on Monday an arrangement to cut tariffs on about **$30 billion** of goods from each side, with tariffs on around **90 percent** of the covered products to be lowered to most-favoured-nation rates. [E3] Xinhua carried the same $30 billion reciprocal cut and the same around-90-percent MFN language. [E2]
RTE, reading the White House farm list bound for China, reported a single operational fact: "It did not include soybeans." [E5]
